messages:
anne: Heads up — PM wants the API surface for Structured Output + function-calling locked by next Wed. We need devex + SDK + docs owners aligned. Who can own Python/TS typings, examples, and changelog?

sam: I can take Python client types + examples. Timeline works if we get the final spec by Tue EOD.

maria: Spec is mostly done. Two open questions: (1) validation: server-side vs client helper? (2) function-calling payload shape — flat args vs nested object. Leaning nested object for ergonomics.

leo: From devex POV we prefer client helper validators + optional runtime warnings (flaggable). Keeps server simpler and lets us ship faster. Also need a clear migration note for existing users.

jamie: Docs will need quickstart snippets, a migration guide, and a changelog entry. Suggest a "migration v2" banner during canary.

sam: Quick TS question — do we want discriminated unions for tool responses? If we go nested object, TS types are straightforward. Example idea:
```ts
type ToolOutput = { name: string; output: Record<string, unknown>; schema?: object }
```

alex: I can own TS types & SDK surface. Plan: branch from `canary/structured-output`, add types in `@redwood/sdk`, then PR examples into docs repo.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: canary pipeline scheduled for 2024-12-15 02:00 UTC if PRs merged to `canary/structured-output` branch.

leo: Proposed launch criteria: unit tests + typing tests for TS, Python mypy checks, two canary customers onboarded, and zero critical regressions for 48h post-canary.

maria: Agree. Also require one enterprise customer's signoff on privacy/KMS contracts for Private deployments before GA.

sam: For the changelog: mark as "minor" unless we change request shapes. If any breaking changes, we'll call it "breaking" and include migration steps. I'll draft entries.

jamie: I'll prep docs pages: Quickstart, advanced examples (tool-calling + structured output), and short migration guide. Include both Python sync/async and TS promise examples.

anne: Owners so far: Python types -> @sam; TS types -> @alex; Docs -> @jamie; Devex helpers -> @leo. I'll create GH epics and link them here.

sam: Added tickets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/412 (python types) and https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/413 (validators).

alex: Will open PR for TS types today. Example snippet I'll include in the PR:
```ts
const res = await client.chat.create({ model: 'rw-1', input: prompt, functions });
console.log(res.output.structured);
```

jamie: :thumbsup: I'll block time for docs review tomorrow at 12:00 UTC.

anne: Can we lock the final spec by Tue morning? @maria please confirm.

maria: Confirmed — final spec doc will be posted by EOD Mon and I'll update this thread with the link.

jamie: One more ask for changelog: include explicit migration steps, minimal code diffs, and a deprecation timeline (>=30 days).

anne: Great. I'll follow up with GH epic links + owner assignments. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly.
